CustomField.label: Price Before Promotion
CustomField.description: Net unit price with every discount except promotions (volume, term, billing frequency and manual discounts): Net Unit Price + the promotion adjustments' applied amount per unit. Blank when no promotion applies. Set by RepriceQuotesPST. Used by Below Floor so promotion discounts don't need floor approval (PRC-18).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Net unit price before the promotion discount. Below Floor compares this price with the floor price, so promotions don't need approval.
